section: Iterate — change: settings and information pages, theme menu, setup status (redesign part 3)
title: Redesign Settings and Info, add a setup status and a German theme menu that follows the system
context: Part 3 of the Papier & Tanne redesign. Settings fields showed the example sender and 'Kanton Zug' as if saved, and a partial save wrote those defaults into storage, so the app could not tell what the midwife had really entered. The theme menu was English, 'System' did not follow OS changes while open, dark users saw a light flash, the page was not marked German and menu focus was nearly invisible.
decision: updateSettings merges onto the raw stored record (no defaults written, JSON shape unchanged) and announces settings-changed after a successful write. A pure setupStatus rule feeds useSetupStatus (useSyncExternalStore, string snapshot); status box, invoice-page hint and header dot read it. German Darstellung radio menu; ThemeProvider follows the OS while 'system'; an inline index.html script applies the theme before the app loads; lang=de. Info rebuilt with tokens, facts unchanged.
consequences: Users see what is actually saved and what is still missing before their first invoice; nothing blocks generating. Export may now omit never-saved fields (import already treats them as defaults). A future CSP needs the inline script's hash. Older stored 'Kanton Zug' counts as a set place. Multi-tab edits can still overwrite each other (unchanged).
rationale: Matches the approved design with identical PDF and file formats; raw reads are the only way to tell saved from default; useSyncExternalStore gives a stable cross-component status without a context; the inline script is the only way to avoid the first-paint flash on a static site. Reviews: spec PASS, code PASS, codex revise (fixed), doubt 1 medium fixed.
rejected: Per-card saving (unsaved edits in the other card silently lost); a React context for setup status (needs a provider, misses other tabs); detecting defaults by text at read time (cannot tell an explicit 'Kanton Zug' from a leaked default); an external theme script file (one more request before first paint).
